notes.title: Ironsmith Medieval Simulator Release!
notes.notes:
Greetings Ironsmiths!

Today marks the day when we grab our hammers and pincers to smith like there is no tomorrow!

You can find the game on Steam with a special premiere discount:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978700/Ironsmith_Medieval_Simulator/

And hear the story of the medieval blacksmith in our Launch Trailer:
[previewyoutube=SOw3Ocu3L-w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Release Date.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905399/ef989395bfb11014d91dedf712ceb88e759b0231.gif
Greetings Blacksmiths!

Grab your trusty hammer, light the forge and mark your calendar for 9th March 2022 as bonk time is coming!

Stay tuned for the upcoming trailer and prepare to become a True ruler of the forge, The master of Hammer and Anvil, The Pincer of Knighthood and The one who Hit.

You are Blacksmith, a true father's son. In the end, knights need you more than you need them.

PS. We have updated our Steam page for your rejoice. Check out the prologue if you haven't yet!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1316640/Ironsmith_Medieval_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello blacksmiths,

We want to reassure all of You that game is still in development. After receiving feedback from our publisher we are busy with optimization, improving the dialogues, adding new languages, and overall debugging. We will need few more months to polish the game.
